text:
Tom: CloudHarbor asks for a shared co-sell POC tenant + simple runbook (provisioning, entitlements, SSO, egress IPs, pricing). They want a draft today.
CloudHarbor: FYI wed like short-lived token access for embeddings during dev and a dev sandbox that mirrors Hosted behavior.
Jaya: Quick answers up front: no prod keys. We can provide scoped dev API keys + time-limited tokens. For Dedicated evals we can give an indicative monthly cost, but pilot credit is easiest for procurement.
Riya: Security note: we need a completed security questionnaire. Ive started filling it; major flags: KMS/HSM "available only in Private", SOC2 artifacts, and data retention SLA clarifications. Link to our draft: https://redwood.internal/secure/CloudHarbor_qna (internal).
Tom: For SSO, what minimal metadata do we need from their IdP? I can send them a short checklist.
Jaya: Minimal SAML checklist: EntityID, IdP metadata XML, assertionConsumerService URL, NameID format, cert (PEM). Example snippet to request: ``<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://idp.cloudharbor.com\">... </EntityDescriptor>``. Also request a test user with the email claim.
Riya: Also ask if they need SCIM provisioning. We can enable SCIM for Dedicated/private sandboxes; Hosted sandboxes will need manual onboarding.
Tom: Egress/Network: they mentioned an on-prem connector and want known outbound IPs for firewall rules. Ops?
ops-bot: infra: requested cloud NAT & NAT IP allocation (req=56821). ETA 2h. Will post IPs when ready.
Jaya: Pricing: option A (Hosted pilot): standard pilot credit = 125k gen tokens + 5k embed units + 30 days support. Option B (Short Dedicated eval): depends on GPU footprint; rough ballpark for 1xA10G pool ~ $12k/week inclusive of reserved infra + support. I will confirm with finance and DM exact numbers.
CloudHarbor: Can you also share entitlement template for API scopes and RBAC?
Riya: Entitlement approach: (1) partner-dev scope (read/write embeddings, generate limited tokens), (2) admin view (monitoring) is optional, (3) no billing access. I'll attach our partner-entitlement template to the shared drive.
Jaya: For the short-lived tokens we use admin endpoint: ``POST /admin/partners/{partner_id}/tokens`` with body ``{"ttl":3600,"scopes":["embed:write","generate:limited"]}``. Tokens are logged and expire automatically.
Tom: Perfect. Riya please attach the security Qs and canned responses to the runbook. Ops please paste NAT IPs here when available. Jaya finalize pricing. I'll assemble and send to partner tomorrow AM and schedule a demo after they confirm access. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: infra: cloud NAT allocated. Outbound IPs: [34.201.12.77, 34.201.12.78]. Sandbox provisioning started for seat cloudharbor-poc-001 (req=56821).
Riya: Uploaded files: partner_entitlement_template_v2.docx, CH_security_responses_v1.pdf, SOC2_artifact_index.xlsx.
Jaya: Finance confirmed ballpark: Hosted pilot (no charge, pilot credits applied) and Dedicated eval estimate updated to ~$11k/week for A10 footprint; will email formal quote.
Tom: Thanks team. I'll send the runbook + checklist to CloudHarbor and cc solutions engineering. If any last blockers post here.
Riya: We'll need a completed SAML metadata file and a primary technical contact from CloudHarbor before we can enable SSO.
CloudHarbor: Sending IdP metadata & primary contact later today. Thanks everyone.
Tom: Closing loop: target demo next Thurs after setup. :calendar:
